findings.title: The deployed site sets HSTS and no other security header
findings.evidence: A request to the production deployment returns strict-transport-security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains; preload, and no content-security-policy, x-content-type-options, referrer-policy or frame-ancestors. There is no vercel.json in the repository, so nothing configures them. Until this branch the site was a shell nobody was sent to; this branch makes it the page a stranger is given, and it can be framed by any site and will sniff a mistyped content type.
findings.fix: Add a vercel.json headers block for the whole site: x-content-type-options: nosniff, referrer-policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and a content-security-policy. The page loads nothing from another origin - its images are bundled and its only links are navigations - so default-src 'self' with frame-ancestors 'none' is close to the whole policy; the one thing to check first is the service worker's registration script.

findings.title: The way in changed and there is no threat model to change
findings.evidence: This branch publishes the first page served to someone with no budget and no account, and adds two images to what the service worker precaches. The project has no threat model: ITEM-8, 'Write the threat model, now that there is no server to model', is open at prepare, and docs/ holds no model for it to change.
findings.fix: ITEM-8 is the work. When it is written, the landing page is one of its entry points: a public static page with no input, whose only powers are two navigations into onboarding and the import path.

summary: Incomplete, with 2 medium findings open and one rule unchecked. The deployed site sets HSTS and no other security header, and there is no vercel.json to set them; and the branch publishes the first public page while the project still has no threat model, which ITEM-8 is open to write. SEC-23 is unchecked: whether the platform still accepts TLS 1.0 is Vercel's setting and this machine cannot offer those protocols to test it.
